source: exported verbatim from browser-storage key 'kw_sweep_p14' produced by chapter/qa-sweep14.html
note: Per-finding production baseline. Findings are in manifest order, then engine emission order within each chapter — not sorted, not deduplicated, not normalised.
method: chapter/qa-sweep14.html — resumable driver, same measurement path as qa-runner.html (render-stability gate: lexicon present + non-empty node signature + 3 consecutive identical samples; injection liveness check; bounded retry ×3; errors never counted as zero).

fieldsNotCapturedByThisRun.severity: qa-engine.js emits findings[].severity; the sweep driver did not store it
fieldsNotCapturedByThisRun.colours: qa-engine.js detail carries colour values (detail.colour for ROLE_CONTRADICTS_BADGE and BLACK_FALLBACK/LINK_BLUE; detail.span + detail.head for HEADWORD_COLOUR_MISMATCH), and detail.cursor for NO_POINTER, detail.roles for LETTER_ROLE_UNSTABLE. The driver stored only badge/role/headword, so no colour values exist in kw_sweep_p14 and none are invented here. Recovering them requires a fresh sweep with an extended driver — deliberately NOT done in this phase.

integrity.checksumAlgorithm: over JSON.stringify([chapter,code,section,index,surface,badge,role,headword]) per finding, joined by \n, in file order
